segments.title: Chương 121: 0121 [Giáng Sinh Lãng Mạn]
segments.content:
Chapter 124: 0121 A Romantic Christmas (Bonus chapter for Alliance Leader Xuan Yuan Qing Huan)

On Christmas Day, a light snow was falling from the sky.

Bian Guanyue skipped class in the afternoon and came over to Beijing University early, afraid that the traffic would be bad on a special day like this.

"Well well, the lady boss is here," Ao Yanchen joked.

Bian Guanyue greeted her, "Senior Ao, Merry Christmas."

Ao Yanchen said, "You're here for CEO Chen, right? He's probably still in class. It's almost finals, he has to keep up appearances."

Chen Guiliang was not actually in class. He had gone to buy a present for Bian Guanyue.

And movie tickets too, which would be hard to get at the last minute tonight.

After chatting for a bit, Ao Yanchen pointed at Xie Yang and said, "That should be your classmate."

Bian Guanyue wasn't surprised. She already knew about this from her text conversations with Chen Guiliang. She walked over at once and said, "Xie Yang, long time no see."

"Bian Guanyue!"

Xie Yang was even more pleasantly surprised. He didn't know many people in Beijing.

Bian Guanyue pulled over a chair and sat next to him. "Have you seen Wu Meng?"

"I saw her as soon as I got here," Xie Yang said. "We should find a time to get Li Rui to come out and meet up too."

After a few sentences of small talk, Bian Guanyue didn't know what else to say. She hadn't been very close with Xie Yang in their last year of high school.

Xie Yang didn't know how to carry the conversation either, so he went to the Sanguosha forum to browse posts. He couldn't help but laugh as he read, "Hahahaha..."

Curious, Bian Guanyue looked at the screen and saw someone had posted: "What if Ma Jiajue came to the world of Sanguosha?"

Ma Jiajue's skill, of course, was swinging a hammer.

It was a true dark humor joke.

Bian Guanyue said, "People at my school play Sanguosha too, and some even buy the physical cards. They order them online."

"The online store's sales have indeed been rising recently," Xie Yang said.

2004 was still too early for Sanguosha.

In another timeline, the inventor of Sanguosha was inspired to create the game only after encountering "BANG!" at a board game cafe in Xizhimen in 2006. He then printed the physical cards and sold them on Taobao. The eighth customer of his Taobao store even joined the Sanguosha team.

But as for now?

Board game cafes were still extremely rare in China, not even in their infancy. Taobao had also just started, and online store sales were truly limited.

Chen Guiliang had already promoted it with all his might, yet he still hadn't sold all 5,000 sets of the physical Sanguosha cards.

Of those, he had also given away over two hundred sets.

However, as the number of users for the online version of "Sanguosha" increased, sales of the physical cards in the online store had been looking up for the past half-month. Chen Guiliang planned to print another ten thousand sets for sale. The larger the print run, the lower the cost.

The physical cards were quite profitable too.

In the original timeline, "Sanguosha" sold over 100,000 sets in its first year, over 600,000 in its second, and broke 1 million in its third. In the fourth year, it sold more than 2 million sets, and by the fifth year, annual sales surpassed 3 million sets.

At this moment, Chen Guiliang was on a bus.

Tao Xue sent him a text message: "Senior, Merry Christmas."

"Merry Christmas to you too."

"Is it snowing in Beijing?"

"A little."

"How romantic. I want to go to Beijing to see the snow."

"Then you have to study hard."

"My brother said you're making a website and a game at the same time. You're so amazing."

"I'm about to die from exhaustion."

"I've seen your Xiaonei Wang. I also went home last weekend and downloaded Sanguosha. Oh, and I bought a set of the physical cards online."

"Haha, don't get them confiscated by the teacher at school."

"Why can't high school students register on Xiaonei Wang?"

"Most high school students don't have computers, and I'm still in the early startup phase. The open beta isn't even over yet. Once the open beta is done, registration will be opened up."

"Every weekend when I'm home, I wait for updates on 'Those Things of the Ming Dynasty'. I'm a Ming Dynasty expert now, you know. My history teacher even praised me for my rich knowledge."

"Study hard and read less of those extracurricular books."

"Hmph, you're the one who wrote that extracurricular book! Did you receive the Christmas present I sent you?"

"I did."

"You didn't even send one back to me."

"I sent it. You should receive it by New Year's Day. Just consider it a New Year's gift."

"Hee hee..."

By the time the bus reached his stop, Chen Guiliang was already getting a headache from their chat.

Why was this little girl still thinking about him?

Chen Guiliang often intentionally didn't reply to her messages to get her to back off, but Tao Xue didn't seem to get the hint.

Perhaps in another two or three years, when Tao Xue got to university, these feelings would probably fade.

Couples in long-distance relationships break up after just a year or two. Tao Xue's one-sided crush probably wouldn't last much longer.

Chen Guiliang stood by the side of the road and called Bian Guanyue.

The two first went to a nearby place for dinner, then took a bus to the Haidian Theater in Zhongguancun.

It had been rebuilt late last year and had relatively modern equipment. There was a main hall that could seat a thousand people, and two smaller halls that could seat 120 each.

Compared to the average salary at the time, movie tickets were damn expensive!

Fortunately, they could get half-price tickets with a student ID.

Bian Guanyue held a bucket of popcorn, feeling a little excited. This was her first time watching a movie with Chen Guiliang.

"Who else!"

On the big screen, Feng Kuzi shouted arrogantly, drawing a wave of laughter from the audience.

Bian Guanyue's eyes were fixed on the screen, but she would peek at the person beside her from time to time. It wasn't until Stephen Chow arrived at Pig Sty Alley and the plot became more engaging that she started to watch the movie with full concentration.

"Hahahaha!"

Waves of laughter erupted one after another.

Especially the part where Lam Tze-chung threw the flying knives and the Landlady chased Stephen Chow, that scene had the entire audience roaring with laughter.

Bian Guanyue had always been easy to amuse, yet she liked to hold back her laughter. Halfway through, her stomach started to hurt from laughing.

"What's wrong?" Chen Guiliang thought she was on her period.

Bian Guanyue clutched her stomach. "I feel a little unwell."

She had laughed so hard she was out of breath.

Chen Guiliang had, of course, seen "Kung Fu Hustle" before. Savoring it again at this moment, he could still be made to laugh.

Some things never go out of style and even become classics, like "Protagonist and Supporting Actor" or "The Thieves' Company."

When they left the theater, it was already past nine at night.

The snow seemed to have gotten heavier.

Bian Guanyue gazed at the snowflakes illuminated by the neon lights, feeling as if the whole world had turned romantic. She suggested, "Let's go build a snowman. I've never built one in my entire life. I was always so envious when I watched it on TV."

"Okay, I want to build a snowman too," Chen Guiliang said.

Not in a hurry to go to the hotel, the two of them chose an empty patch of ground by the roadside and began gathering the thin layer of snow, piling up the snowman's body bit by bit.

Then they found some wooden sticks and stuck them on the sides for arms.

Bian Guanyue walked two circles around the snowman. "This snowman is pretty big. Let's make him a little snowman girlfriend."

So, Chen Guiliang went to gather more snow.

Neither of them was wearing gloves. By the time they finished building the two snowmen, their hands were red and stiff from the cold.

Chen Guiliang unzipped his down jacket and placed Bian Guanyue's hands inside his clothes to warm them up.

"It's so warm."

Bian Guanyue simply snuggled into his arms, her hands hidden inside his jacket, holding him tight.

The weather was very cold, but being together made it warm.

Under the dim yellow streetlights, next to the two snowmen, a young man and woman kissed amidst the drifting snowflakes.

Until Bian Guanyue was out of breath.

She pulled a scarf out from her clothes and put it on Chen Guiliang, saying, "Don't you dare laugh at my terrible skills. The first time I knitted it, it came out bad, so I unraveled it and knitted it all over again."

"It's very nice," Chen Guiliang said, holding one end of the scarf to admire it.

"Eek, it's so cold!"

Bian Guanyue shivered and quickly pulled up the hood of her down jacket too, leaving only half of her little face exposed.

Chen Guiliang laughed. "Haha, you look like a penguin like this."

Bian Guanyue said coquettishly, "You have to be a penguin too."

She helped Chen Guiliang zip his jacket up to his neck and urged him to put on his hood. And thus, one big penguin was born.

Chen Guiliang deliberately started waddling like a penguin.

Bian Guanyue giggled at the sight and began to imitate him.

Childish.

But warm and joyful.

After laughing and playing for a while, it was simply too cold. They had to find a warm place.

The hotel Chen Guiliang had booked was not far from here. Hand in hand, they arrived after a short walk.
